extra.reason: Observed on a live fleet 2026-09-14. Three consecutive spawns into session afox: both user-style panes (devin TESTER, codex REVIEWER) came up running hold.sh with @held=1, no devin or codex process existed (checked against pane pids), and the repo working tree gained no files. A fourth probe spawn with gemini, copilot and goose roles held all three the same way. Releasing the panes (./fleet.sh --release) started devin and codex, which each answered one line and then sat idle. The idle state comes from hold.sh not starting the provider at all, not from the appended stand-down line. README Unverified entry for non-claude pane idling deleted, provider table updated, SPECS.md #8 moved to Met.

Every shortcut was pressed by the user on the live fleet window in session afox, 2026-09-14, and each result was read back from tmux. Prefix delivery works: the double-tap split took the fleet window from 5 panes to 6, prefix+arrow moved the active pane from ORCHESTRATOR to the new pane, and prefix+x+y killed it and returned the window to 5. The README claim that the prefix does nothing was wrong. Clicking a pane moved the active pane to REVIEWER; typing exit in a throwaway pane closed it. Two rows, new window and detach, were never pressed, so they were deleted from the table rather than left as untested claims. The arrow row was reworded: it moves the cursor, not the pane. Option-drag and Shift-drag were both tried and neither restores native text selection while the mouse is on, so that sentence was corrected instead of repeated. Mouse stays on by the user's decision, trading text selection for click-to-focus. README Unverified entry for prefix delivery deleted. No change to tmux.conf was needed.
